title: The Hen Rules the Rooster Clock
text: The Hen Rules the Rooster Clock. [[ASIN:B00FE5OSFE Hens Rule Clock, 12"-48" , Whisper Quiet, non-ticking]]  This clock is not only attractive, but is sturdily made and also whisper-quiet, as claimed.  I purchased one for my mom who loves roosters.  It looks great in her kitchen with it's vintage appearance and cute saying and has a very convenient battery operated mechanism.  Great kitchen clock for any Rooster afficianado!
